t: Purchase an alchemy manual from Maas-Shakar and read it. Purchase a wooden Pestle and use it to prepare common stain remover. Report to Maas-Shakar.

Aho! You think, you can easily master Alchemy? Well, any profession has its natural born adepts. Put all your tyalla in Alchemy and it will let you master it, eysh!

Take this manual and the wooden pestle and try to prrepare common stain remover. Be prroud of your work, for this stain remover will serve the cause of virtue - the annual cleaning of the Temple!
Any akara can just mix components, eysh! Finding the right proportion - that is the real trick...

Rready? Let me trry... No, nothing will happen to me. My orrganism is already resistant to poisoning, so this stuff will do me no harm...

Yikes. The concentration is just perfect. That's a good starrt for an apprrentice!
Purchase a Sickle and Ether from Maas-Shakar, obtain 5 Potent Chamomiles and brew 5 Weak Potions of Healing. Report to Maas-Shakar in the Residence.

Gathering herbs is an imporrtant part of Alchemist's life. Sometimes your quest leads you farther than any experienced hunter has ever been! You crrawl up and down the hills until your fur is grreen on your knees - all for the sake of a couple of prrecious flowers. You need to learn that lesson, eysh!

Take that Sickle and find 5 Potent Chamomiles. Mix them with Ether to prrepare Weak Potions of Healing. You can buy Ether from me.

Come back as soon as you finish.
Don't mix it up! You need chamomiles and not some meadow weed!

The color looks right... Come on, let me taste it.

Huh! Not bad. I don't even feel the pain in my knees anymore. Congrratulations, alchemist! Your potion is superb, eysh!
Purchase a blacksmithing manual from Hummer the Nimble and read it. Buy an Apprentice's Portable Forge and use it to forge a Rare Utility Rake. Report to Hummer the Nimble.

So what are you going to say? You want to be a blacksmith, right? Dig for ore, heat the forge, swing the hammer, right?

Go on, make up your mind already. It's a decent profession. Just take this manual.

Remember to read it carefully! When I was a rookie, I didn't know all my letters, but it worked out all right! I guess I just had natural talent. Now I'm one of the best blacksmiths in the world.

Don't forget to purchase your tools. Your fists are strong, but not strong enough to forge iron, huh!
To learn blacksmithing, you need to read that training manual!
Good decision! Here, take this. You'll need it.
Purchase a Rusty Pick and 11 doses of Tallow from Hummer the Nimble. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots. Report to Hummer the Nimble.

Who needs utility rake at war? Soldiers need ammunition! And boots. Listen up.

Every blacksmith must be capable of mining ore. Take the pick and go search for copper ore near Nezebgrad. There are lots of them, regardless that the city is near. If someone else turns out to be faster than you, and you find the mine empty, don't be upset. Just wait for a while, and the mine will replenish with ore once again. Of course, you may simply buy ore at an auction.

As soon as you gather Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots, take some tallow, and there you are, ready to forge the Copper Boots! I'll check their quality later.
So, have you got the boots?
Not as bad as I thought. Quite good ones, I'd say. You can wear them yourself. And here's your gift for the first lesson learned - upgrader for your next tool. You'll make use of it in the future.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Hummer the Nimble is the name. What do you need?

No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements.
Now, to the craft. Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you craft. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The highest available skill level in blacksmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics. Also, we can create tools to work with equipment pieces and staples - you will need those at the highest development level.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
If you got away with a smaller number of reforges, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.

t: Purchase a blacksmithing manual from Vlad Kononov and read it. Buy an Apprentice's Portable Forge and use it to forge a Rare Utility Rake. Report to Vlad Kononov.

So, you think you want to be a blacksmith, huh? I hope you realize that a master blacksmith is always buried in work! That means that anyone who dares to become a master of the hammer and anvil will never have a shortage of orders!

You'll probably never find the time to ever start a family... Oh, what I am saying? If you want to learn my trade, I'm not going to stop you. All you'll need to do is buy the training manual and tools from me.
To learn blacksmithing, you need to read that training manual!
Did you read it? All of it? Good. Now you can be my apprentice. I'll teach you everything I know!
Purchase a Rusty Pick and 11 doses of Tallow from Vlad Kononov. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots. Report to Vlad Kononov.

Now that you are familiar with the basics of blacksmithing, it's high time to study mining and learn how to obtain metal ore. What does it take? A pick! You can buy one from me, I've got an old and cheap one. Take the pick and go search for copper ore near Novograd. There are lots of them, regardless that the city is near. If someone else turns out to be faster than you, and you find the mine empty, don't be upset. Just wait for a while, and the mine will replenish with ore once again. Of course, you may simply buy ore at an auction.

Purchase a Rusty Pick and Tallow. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots!
Go on, work, work! Do the clink clank!
Not bad! These boots will keep your feet warm and safe in combat. Good job! Well done!
My goods are, you know, good!
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.

Vlad Kononov, blacksmith. Do you know what a blacksmith is? They are the embodiment of strength, agility, and dexterity! I'm telling you, I can hit even a flea! You have no idea how much armor I've made. The whole League Army wears my armor! And what are you doing here? What is it that you need?

t: Purchase a blacksmithing manual from Saad Kagan and read it. Buy an Apprentice's Portable Forge and use it to forge a Rare Utility Rake. Report to Saad Kagan.

Aho! Do you like the smell of hot iron? The ringing of gold? Heat and flames? Then blacksmithing is your vocation, eysh!

Let's begin with the easiest thing. Want to trry your hand? Then listen. The tillage season is coming. Pridens will need a lot of rakes. It doesn't take to be a grreat master to make one! Just make sure it is solid.

Take the manual and the Portable Forge. Go on, forrge the best rake Howlem has ever seen!
Nice worrk! This rake can plow up rrocks, eysh!
Purchase a Rusty Pick and 11 doses of Tallow from Saad Kagan. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Impure Copper Ingots and forge Copper Boots. Report to Saad Kagan in the Residence.

The firrst lesson is learned. Now let's prroceed with more advanced crrafts! Now you will have to extrract ore by yourself. It can be found everywhere on Howlem, just take this pick and go find some. Melt 5 chunks into 5 ingots. You will need some tallow for that.

From ingots, you can forge whatever you want! But first make Copper Boots for me! Yes, that's correct. I was astonished, too. Some cranky lady's wolverine won't stop biting her feet. Huh! She should have learned how to handle these beasts first.
Unusual request, huh? Huh! It makes me wonder, too.
Ahem... Well, they don't come off. And the size seems just rright. Well done! I will rremember you. A couple dozens years of prractice - and you will be able to forrge my real-size statue!

No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements. You don't mind starting with that, zoor?

Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore and then cast it in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies. So do that as often as possible, eysh!

The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you can work on at least two parts at a time. This isn't so hard to remember, zoor?
Purchase a leatherworking manual from Karim Shagrenin and read it. Buy an Apprentice Leatherworker's Tool Belt and use it to sew a Rare Leather Bridle. Report to Karim Shagrenin.

I'm glad you're taking interest in leatherworking.

Frankly, I'm one of the only master leatherworkers and there's more work coming in than I can handle. For your first task it'd be great if you could get started on the bridle our stable master has been requesting. I've been putting it off for quite some time and it's not fair to keep him waiting.

Just come back when you're done with the work and I'll be sure to inspect it for quality when it's complete.
Work on, comrade! Deadline is near!
Loot two Training Leather Fragments from city Ravens, prepare them using pincers and sew leather boots. Report to Karim Shagrenin.

Remember that the Empire needs only best craftsmen, capable of providing our army with the best armor and equipment! Alas, we don't have much time for teaching you things, because we're overloaded with orders. But I can give you loads of exercise. Go to the Old Square, kill as many Ravens as you can and loot their skins. Use pincers to cut the leather, and then you can sew leather boots!

The leather you need is sold at an auction, as well.

You will also need Rough Thread, which you can buy from me. It's rough, but tough, as we leatherworkers say!
Careful with the needles. When I was young, I used to be an adventurer, like you... then I took a needle to the knee.
Very good boots. They surely won't fall apart in a day or two! Even better than I'd expected. Welcome to the ranks of leatherworkers!
Purchase a leatherworking manual from Raw Family and read it. Buy an Apprentice Leatherworker's Tool Belt and use it to sew a Rare Leather Bridle. Report to Raw Family.

We have an urgent order! League Defenders want several leather bridles for their horses! And we're so overloaded... You say, you want to become a leatherworker? Here's your manual, take it and read it.

Can you give us a hand now? Make a Rare Leather Bridle, will you? We will provide you with the ingredients, and give you a reward after you've finished.

So?
Don't worry, I wouldn't give you anything too complicated to finish!
Wow! I'm impressed. Keep putting in this type of quality with your work and you'll be able to catch up to me in skills in no time at all!
Loot two Training Leather Fragments from Gray Wolves, prepare them using pincers and sew leather boots. Report to Raw Family.

So, you're eager to become a leatherworker? Good on you! Let me find you an interesting order... Ah, here's one. An order placed by an elf, for common leather boots, plain and old-fashioned. He said that's the trend.

First of all, you will need leather. It is rather easy to obtain it. Just go to the forest, kill a few Gray Wolves a loot their skins. Then cut it into stripes using Pincers. To sew the boots you will need Rough Thread. That's all!

What's wrong? Have you ever tried to rip a wolf of its skin? No? You can buy the leather you need at an auction, then.
Oh this fashion of elves! It's driving us nuts.

The same elf came by and canceled the previous order. Don't you worry, he fully paid for it. Now he wants velvet boots with dragons of gold and pompoms.

Oh, you say the boots are ready? Let me see. They're wonderful! Now, as long as the customer doesn't want them, you can wear them yourself!
Purchase a leatherworking manual from Laan-Rahor and read it. Buy an Apprentice Leatherworker's Tool Belt and use it to sew a Rare Leather Bridle. Report to Laan-Rahor.

A good leatherworker is always in demand. When the winter comes, all Pridens wear clothes that we made for them. And hunters need special clothing throughout the whole year!

We have many fine cubs this year, eysh. Will you help me with the orrders? I will give you the easiest ones. If you can handle them, I will be your trrainer.

Try a crrude Bridle for a start. Anyone who has two hands can make it. Take the manual and the tool belt first.
Huh... Alright. Well, it's better than I expected. You will make a good leatherworker if you trry hard enough!
Loot two Training Leather Fragments from Cowardly Jackals, prepare them using pincers and sew leather boots. Report to Laan-Rahor in the Residence.

It's time to entrust you with a more serrious job. We make special boots for hunters to prrotect their feet from thorns when they chase animals. They don't completely cover feet, so the binding system is complicated.

Also, you need to learn how to obtain materrials on your own. Go to the Foothills, hunt several jackals, and excoriate them. Then cut the skins with pincers. Come back to me to buy some rough tread and start sewing.

It's really simple. For those who have been sewing for ages.
The boots are ready? If you learn how to sew them, you will learn how to sew anything, eysh!
Ah-hya! Nice boots! You are gifted. Do not neglect your talent!
Purchase a tailoring manual from Yana Beketova and read it. Purchase an Apprentice's Sewing Case and use it to sew a Fine Handkerchief. Report to Yana Beketova.

Have you ever seen the elven-made clothes? Such a shame! They're nothing but cuts and laces, and reveal the body to all possible kinds of damage. Can you imagine that? They won't protect you even against a fly! It's obvious that they shouldn't import this disgust to the Empire, but they simply won't stop! So we decided to increase quality of our own products. The Imperial clothes are sturdy and protect you well, but we have to make them prettier.

I need a decent sample. A nice and fine handkerchief will do. Sew one and bring it to me. It'll be a good exercise for you, too.
Have you seen the elven dress? All lace and frill!

Wonderful! These came out nicely.
Remember, the elven clothes are not fit for a true Imperial soldier!
Purchase Copper Scissors and Weak Thread from Yana Beketova. Obtain Training Fabric and cut it into two Calico Rolls. Sew Cozy Slippers. Report to Yana Beketova.

Remember, that the Empire needs only best craftsmen, capable of providing our army with the best armor and equipment! Alas, we don't have much time for teaching you things, because we're overloaded with orders. But I can give you loads of exercise.

Go to the Hadron Quarter, kill a few skeletons. I heard they have fabric on them. You may simply buy the Training Fabric from an auction. Use copper scissors to cut the fabric, take some thread, and then you can sew Cozy Slippers!
Damned war... Work, work all day, no rest...
These slippers look so cozy, that I want to wear them immediately.

t: I'm Yana Beketova, a fourth generation tailor. Nezeb himself wore clothes that were made by my great grandmother! So, how can I help you?

No one but us tailors can craft clothes from fabric or make cloaks. Besides, we possess the knowledge how to make necklaces.
Now, about the process itself. Use a sewing kit to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The threads required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Embroidery, lace, buttons and beads can be used as they are, while fabric rolls have to be cut with scissors first.
The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and retailor the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you.
The maximum available level of tailoring equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
By the way, if you ever need lower-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.
If you got away with a smaller number of retailoring attempts, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try and make epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every craftsman decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
h: Ask about tips for experienced tailors

h: Learn how to become a tailor

t: What patterns would you like to buy?
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Purchase a tailoring manual from Valentina de Ardeur and read it. Purchase an Apprentice's Sewing Case and use it to sew a Fine Handkerchief. Report to Valentina de Ardeur.

Do you appreciate beauty? Do you rely more on magic, than on physical might? Do you want to earn well? Tailoring is the craft for you then!

I can sell you the manual and starting kit. This is all you need for a start. It won't take long, but it's talent that it really takes. Don't you worry, I'll be helping you along the way.

Your first lesson is to sew a fine handkerchief for me.
Not so bad at all! Such a small piece of fabric turned into a fine piece of art! Now let's get down to something serious.
Purchase Copper Scissors and Weak Thread from Valentina de Ardeur. Obtain Training Fabric and cut it into two Calico Rolls. Sew Cozy Slippers. Report to Valentina de Ardeur.

Selecting the right fabric for your creations is as important, as the skill of making correct patterns. You need to learn how to obtain the material.

Cutting the fabric also requires decent tools. You can buy sharp copper scissors from me. Training fabric can be looted, for example, from Forest Agitators in northern Lightwood. That's the kind of fabric that you won't be sorry about, if something goes wrong. You may also buy Training Fabric at an auction. Cut the fabric into Calico Rolls, take Rough Thread and sew Cozy Slippers for me.
Start with something simple, then progress to something more complex... that will make you a fortune!
These slippers are so cozy! Any old lady would be happy to wear them. Now you are a real tailor!
Purchase a tailoring manual from Gaal-Mahra and read it. Purchase an Apprentice's Sewing Case and use it to sew a Fine Handkerchief. Report to Gaal-Mahra.

Aho, kid. You want to study tailoring? A dress sewed by a professional tailor is light as a breath of wind and comfortable as a crib. Both young and old wear our clothes all year rround. This is why our job is so important. What would be the difference between us and Savages if were walking naked?

If you want to become a tailor, I will teach you everything you need to know. Take the manual, the Apprentice's Sewing Case and its upgrader. Then trry your hand at something simple. For instance, make a Fine Handkerchief for me.
Clumsy stitches can be different, eysh. They can show whether the sewer has a talent or not. I wonder which is your case.
Ah-hya, that is not bad at all! I did not expect to find such a talent among the youngsters!
Purchase Copper Scissors and Weak Thread from Gaal-Mahra. Obtain Training Fabric and cut it into two Calico Rolls. Sew Cozy Slippers. Report to Gaal-Mahra in the Residence.

Since the basics are so easy for you, let's trry something more difficult. Young women fancy these strange leg decorations that the tailless wear, eysh. Of course, we cannot make them the same for our paws, but I trried to do my best to make comfortable and lovely shoes for our girls.

You want to try and sew a pair? Firrst you will have to obtain training fabric. Cut it with scissors and sew the strripes with the thread. You can buy it all frrom me.

I wonder what it is going to look like, zoor?
Any hunter in ambush would envy tailor's patience!
Perrfect! It is better than I expected. You deserve the rright to be called a tailor, eysh!
Purchase a weaponsmithing manual from Aurora Bulatina and read it. Purchase Apprentice Weaponsmith's Tools and use them to craft a Rare Whetstone. Report to Aurora Bulatina.

Stay sharp, comrade! The war is on! With the League on one side, demons on the other, and all kinds of monsters all around... What can save the Motherland in these hard times? Nothing but strong steel in our fighters' hands!

The Empire may have plenty of defenders, but sharp swords are always in short supply. So don't hesitate, comrade, and become a weaponsmith! Buy a manual and tools, roll up your sleeves and get started!
You need to use the manual to learn weaponsmithing.
Congratulations on becoming a weaponsmith! Let's get started. If you're diligent, you'll learn very fast!
Here, take it! Let me know if you need more.

Weaponsmiths are always in demand: we make swords and spiked clubs, bows and crossbows, and even magic wands. But before you get down to crafting weapons, you'll have to practice making kitchen knives and simple hammers.
Now, about the process itself. Use weaponsmith's tools, learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the correct components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. Parts will be harder to obtain. Rods, tips, bases, blades, braidings, additives, flux, granulations, enamels... All of that can be obtained by fighting enemies or bought from other heroes.

Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
I'm Aurora Bulatina, I teach weaponsmithing to newbies. You have any questions, feel free to ask them.
Purchase a Rusty Pick and 12 doses of Tallow from Aurora Bulatina. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Copper Tips and forge Copper Knife. Report to Aurora Bulatina.

You've got the basics? Good. Now let's get down to common practice.

You will need enough resources for you craft. You may either mine for ore or buy it at an auction. In any case, you must be able to do it yourself. Buy a Rusty Pick and mine a few Impure Copper Chunks near Nezebgrad. As I said, they're always available at the auction.

You can melt them then into Copper Tips, and use the tips to craft a Copper Knife. Another needful thing in weaponsmithing is Tallow.

Let's consider it your final exam.
Is the knife ready? I expect it to be perfect!
That is a good knife, sharp and durable. You have passed your exam. Here's your reward!
Purchase a weaponsmithing manual from Zoritsa Kovaleva and read it. Purchase Apprentice Weaponsmith's Tools and use them to craft a Rare Whetstone. Report to Zoritsa Kovaleva.

Tailors make clothes for sorcerers, while blacksmiths equip armor-clad warriors. There is only one profession that everyone definitely needs: weaponsmiths. Choose this path and you'll never lack for work: you'll have enough orders for a hundred years ahead. You'll be able to craft a sword or a bow for a warrior, a dagger or a wand for a mage, and you'll always find a treat for yourself too, seeing as you can make any weapon you might want. Sounds great, eh? Make up your mind: you only need to buy tools and a manual to become a weaponsmith.
You need to use the manual to learn weaponsmithing.
Did you read it? All of it? Good. Now you can be my apprentice. I'll teach you everything I know!
Purchase a Rusty Pick and 12 doses of Tallow from Zoritsa Kovaleva. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Copper Tips and forge Copper Knife. Report to Zoritsa Kovaleva.

Well, you know now what weaponsmithing is all about. What you need now is practice, the more the better! But that's not all: you need raw materials too. To mine them, you will need a pick, which you can buy from me. It's a bit rusty, but it'll do for the first time.

Take the pick and go search for copper ore near Novograd. There are lots of them, regardless that the city is near. If someone else turns out to be faster than you, and you find the mine empty, don't be upset. Just wait for a while, and the mine will replenish with ore once again. Of course, you may simply buy ore at an auction.

You can melt raw copper into Copper Tips and then craft a Copper Knife. Don't forget about Tallow, you're going to need it.
Go on, work, work! Do the clink clank!
Well done! Here's your reward - you will find it useful!
Purchase a weaponsmithing manual from Khoor-Tabira and read it. Purchase Apprentice Weaponsmith's Tools and use them to craft a Rare Whetstone. Report to Khoor-Tabira in the Residence.

Aho! So, you love weapons? That's good! You have the blood of a real hunter in your veins. Maybe you will make a good weaponsmith!

I can teach you the basics of weaponsmithing. Right now, I need a new whetstone. Will you make it for me? It is nothing difficult - you just take the manual and read it. Of courrse, you will need your tools. You can obtain all these from me.

Then go on and work on it until you crraft a whetstone that is good enough for sharpening hunhurr fangs!
The Whetstone is ready? Don't make me wait, kylys!
Perrfect, eysh! You can keep the Whetstone. Now when I see your talent, I know you will make use of it.
Purchase a Rusty Pick and 12 doses of Tallow from Khoor-Tabira. Gather five Impure Copper Chunks, melt them into Copper Tips and forge Copper Knife. Report to Khoor-Tabira in the Residence.

It is time for us to move to a more complicated stage, kylys. To weapons! But before you can forrge your first blade, you need to learn something very imporrtant. Good weaponsmiths always collect materials by themselves. They dig out ore with their hands and develop it properly. This is how a decent weapon is born!

Take this trraining pick and go find some copper ore. It is found all over Howlem. Then take some tallow from me and melt copper chunks into tips. Only then you will be able to forge a blade that will be rightfully yours, eysh!
I will keep an eye on you, apprentice!
Excellent! You are a talented weaponsmith. One day you will forrge the grreatest blade in the world, eysh! I am prroud to be your teacher.
Talk to Semer Nemar in Yasker’s Tower.
Find Semer Nemar and ask him about the mysterious message.
Who knows, perhaps soon we will learn to use the chips for something other than runes?
Well, good luck with your research! I admit I envy you a little.
Talk to the Mysterious Family in the Gibberling District.
You must find the Mysterious Family and ask them about the message.
Who knows, perhaps soon we will learn to use the chips for something other than runes?
I hope you have enough chips! This thing must have plenty of uses!
Find fragrant chamomiles, gather bouquets and exchange them for goods from the Holiday Committee Official.

Fall and its wonderful holidays are approaching! Holiday Committee Officials will give you anything for a bouquet of fragrant chamomiles! Well, maybe not anything, but you can definitely get Marquis's Treasure Map and Marquis's Seal for it.
A gallant chevalier will stand by his only soul mate and never do her harm. Remember that ladies are jealous, and they have sharp claws!
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier

t: Sorry, I can't help you with that. Ask other Holiday Committee Officials.
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: My advice is quite simple. When you're in somebody's arms, keep quiet and don't start a dispute. Otherwise there's always a risk of finding yourself on the ground!
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady

t: Sorry, I can't help you with that. Ask other Holiday Committee Officials.
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: Find a clearing with nimble hares, catch one of them, then bring it to the merchant.

They say hare races are popular with the local merchants. One of them, Gorislav Trubin, will give you Marquis's Treasure Map and Marquis's Seal for a nimble hare. Onward, my ameowzing lordlady! After the hares!
Find a clearing with hares, catch one of them, then bring it to the tavern to exchange it.

They say hare races are popular around here. They are held in the local tavern. The lovely tavern owner will give you Marquis's Treasure Map and Marquis's Seal in exchange for nimble hares. It's a good deal! Onward, my ameowzing lordlady! After the hares!
Learn from Marquis where special goods are located and exchange them for Marquis's Treasure Maps and Marquis's Seals.

MilordMilady!

I found out where you can exchange various curiosities for special treasure maps! These maps show the path to an aristocratic title and other regalia.

I will inform you of the latest news about these maps every day. Meow, be sure to come!
Just a little more and you will become a truly royal person, my ameowzing lordlady!
Use this compass to collect 10 missing gifts in the Holy Land and bring them to Polina Smilina in Nezebgrad.

We need to collect all gifts that we can find in the Holy Land. Can you imagine that... Gifts all over Tensess Temple, the Merry Forest, even the anomalies of Coba Plateau! At least Prospectors will enjoy this New Year!

Happily, even the Arisen understand the importance of the holiday. Their scientists have improvised this compass. It will locate the gifts. All you have to do is follow the needle and collect them!

Be careful, though. I don't think that storm came out of nowhere. Some dark forces may be behind it...
What if they all fell into the swamp? What then?!

That's marvelous! They are mostly intact. Thank you!

But many of the gifts are still in the Holy Land. We need to find them before it's too late. Come again tomorrow - we will continue the search.
Help Holiday Committee Officials collect gifts in the Holy Land five times. Return to Polina Smilina.

It's a disaster!

We've ordered a huge shipment of New Year gifts from the famous Miracle Factory. Yesterday the ship, loaded with gifts, got into an Astral storm near the Holy Land! The shields were breached, and the ship almost crashed... and the gifts spilled all over the allod!

Please, help us! We are asking for help from everyone, but we still don't think it's enough. We need to save the holiday before it's too late!

Are we saved? Are the gifts saved? Oh, let me kiss you!

Thank you so much! There would be no New Year without you! Believe me, saving such an important holiday is a great deed!

You must be rewarded generously. Here, take this! This talisman will teach you to summon a magical goatling. It's very cute and swift! They produce all kinds of curios things on that Miracle Factory...

Happy New Year!
Use this compass to collect 10 missing gifts in the Holy Land and bring them to Evdokia Bubentsova in Novograd.

Oh, thank you for your help! Our elves have already come up with a magical device that will help you find the gifts! It is called the Winter compass. You just need to follow the needle and pick up the gifts!

But be careful! I can sense that something is wrong... The sailors said that the storm was an unusual one; it started unexpectedly and ended swiftly. I am afraid that some evil spirits want to spoil our holiday... Don't let them do that!
What if they all fell into the swamp? What then?!

You found them? Ah, thank you!

But the shipment was huge, and dozens of gifts are still scattered over the Holy Land... Come again tomorrow - we will continue the search.
Help Holiday Committee Officials collect gifts in the Holy Land five times. Return to Evdokia Bubentsova.

Ah, what do we do? Such a terrible thing has happened. We asked those masters from the Miracle Factory to produce some magical gifts for the people... They can do wonderful things!

So they did everything on time, and packed everything nicely... And shipped them out yesterday. That's when the trouble started!

The ship got into a storm near the Holy Land! Can you imagine that? The crew wasn't hurt, but the gifts were less lucky... They got scattered all over the allod. And we don't have the time to order new ones. So... we need to save what we can save. Or there will be no New Year!

Can you help us?

Phew! I think that's all that we can save. And it's a lot! I hope Lamias, Prospectors, and Eljune settlers will enjoy the rest of the gifts...

Thank you so much. I would like to give you this hoof as a sign of gratitude. Throw it on the ground, and it will turn into a swift and lively goatling! He will be a faithful friend of yours.

Happy New Year!
Listen, everyone! All residents of Sarnaut are invited to join the celebration of the Annniversary! The most important people are gathering on the greatest astral battle dreadnought - the Eclipse.
Go to the lower deck and fly on a sailplane.
Want to paint the sky with fires? You can find sailplanes on the lower deck. Pick one and go on a flight! Blow up gold orbs and earn points to receive a generous reward.
The Anniversary Lion lottery is held every day! The first twenty winners will receive this unique mount
What's your score? The higher your score, the more prizes you get!
Welcome to the Eclipse, dear guests! Come here, I'll give you directions!
Welcome to the Eclipse, dear guests! Come here, I'll give you directions!

Many interesting events take place on the Eclipse!

You can go on a tour of the Holy Land. Another ship will take you there!

Guests can also participate in fist fights and a battle of sailplanes!

You can also converse with other guests, set off fireworks, or join a lottery where you can win an Anniversary Lion!
h: Ask about the list of events

t: Two Great Mages are on the ship right now – Yasker and Aidenus! They entrusted their allods to their students so they could attend this celebration!
Demon Hunters are also here! They would like you to fight them in the ring.
Be on the boarding device at the scheduled time – a ship will take you to the Holy Land and back.
h: Ask about tours of the Holy Land

t: There are sailplanes on the lower deck – everyone can test-drive them.
If you need to get rid of anniversary coins quickly, visit the Coin Master!

Open Astral Wormhole, catch 5 young demons using the Demonic Eye and return to Bulat Jerohin.

The Demonic Eye can be used anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.
Don't lose the Eye! It's a very valuable thing.

Look, there they are. Nasty mugs!

What took you so long? The Eye won't hold them forever. In fact, it will hold them for a really short time. I told you that, you just weren't listening!

So, here is your reward. I will deal with these boys. If you want to hunt again, feel free to come at any time!

Open Astral Wormhole, catch 5 young demons using the Demonic Eye and return to Krasimir Chernov.

The Demonic Eye can be used anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

Hello there! I can see citizens are way too feather-bedded in your capital! That's not surprising - what can you be afraid of behind these thick walls? Demons are somewhere far away... Huh! Not today!

Here, take this Eye. It can open up an Astral wormhole right here! All sorts of nasty things will crawl out of it, and you need to capture them. It's easy - first you beat up a demon, then enchant it with its reflection in the magic Eye - and there it is, miniaturized and trapped inside of it!

Catch five of them and come back. We will use them to hunt bigger demons!
Fight with Glum the Rough-House, Lanky the Quiet and Fang.

It's so boring here! No decent warriors to be seen anywhere. Well, no wonder - what would they do in the capital?

However, we are here and we are in trouble! Our fighters are sick and tired of fighting each other. They know each others' moves too well. They need a new blood!

Are you ready to drop your weapons and try yourself at fistfight? Then welcome to the ring! Of course, you won't fight for nothing. If you win, we will reward you with an Anniversary coin. If you don't, well, we won't take anything from you, don't worry!

Go talk to our three fighters. They will take you to the ring right away!

Glum is a lousy fighter, whatever he thinks of himself. He doesn't know a darn thing about defense. Lanky, that's the real rock! You've got to try real hard before she even notices your blows.

Well, Fang is something. He's as strong as a bear and as cunning as a thousand Astral demons! Very few can beat him, that's for sure.

How did you like it?

Come again, if you wish! You are always welcomed at the ring. The people are hungry for bread and circuses! Who are we to deny them that?

Aho.

It's not easy to defeat me – land at least fifteen hits.

Bet a gold coin on your victory. You might get lucky.
Hm... It looks like you don't have any gold.
Rejoice in victory, akyly. Take some rest now.
Huh! Come again later, when you are well-rested.
Tease demons in the cages near Krasimir Chernikov 10 times.

Constant rumpus, weird odors, lazy and arrogant citizens. That's what the capital is like!

I can see you're not one of them. Pleased to meet you. We are Demon Hunters, and we came here to take a break from our routine slaughter in the Astral. Everybody needs rest!
Tease demons in the cages near Bulat Jerohin 10 times.

Look at them! The terror of Sarnaut! The great Astral threat!

They're just miserable critters. They have nothing but pointless desire to kill and destroy. It's in their nature. One day you will even stop hating them and start killing them as easily as you kill mosquitos.

But still you can have some fun! Here's how we amuse ourselves: the one who can touch a demon 10 times without losing their fingers, gets a coin!

Well, if you do lose a finger or two, that's your problem. Just don't do it if you don’t want to!
These demons look too calm. We should fix that, don't you think?

Not bad! These scratches are nothing, don't you worry.

You can tease them again, if you want to. The rules are the same - a coin for each ten pokes!
Complete Bulat Jerohin's quests and kill 5 dangerous demons.

Let's get to the business. We're having a nice time here in the capital, but we didn't come here to rest.

Something weird is happening in the Astral. Demons... are running. They don't just ramble around, they all fly in one direction, as if they are chasing something. Or escaping...

I don't know what is going on, but it can't be good. Why? Because now they are also hiding on allods! Like the ones that we caught and caged.

We, Demon Hunters, hunt them and destroy. But we don't have enough people. You look tough enough for this kind of job. What do you say? Will you help us?
I will try and help you find demons that you can defeat on your own. Don't think it's so easy though!

So this is it. You've done what you had to, now it's all up to us!

However, I've never seen demons behaving so strangely. And we better find out why before it's too late.

This is none of your concern now, anyway. Here is your reward. Good luck and have fun!

Find and destroy Moloch.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

So... Your first objective. Let's see.

Ah, Moloch! That's one ugly creature. And smart, too - he never attacks experienced hunters.

But today it's not going to help him. I have adjusted this visor to Moloch's energy. You just need to locate him and destroy him!
So, have you killed the monster?

Perfect! Another peaceful day for the people of Sarnaut, who have no idea how hard we work to keep them safe...

Anyway, you did a great job. Have you ever considered becoming a Demon Hunter? We would be honored to have a  like you in our ranks!

Find and destroy Augur.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

So... Your second objective. Let's see.

Huh, Augur. This demon can control Astral magic, so be careful. Though there is no way he can hide from us!

I have adjusted this visor to Augur's energy. Show him how we deal with magic!

Find and destroy Chantress.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

Your third objective... Huh, fate has some sense of humor indeed.

You are offered the honor to kill Chantress. She is a terrible monster. Once she attacked a distant allod of Free Traders and enchanted all their kids with her sweet voice right in the middle of the night... In the morning, the trackers found their traces that led to the shore.

They all fell into the Astral. Every single one of them.

I have adjusted this visor to Chantress' energy. I hope you will find her and give her a painful death!

Find and destroy Walker.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

So, the fourth is... Walker.

There is nothing special about him. Just an extremely strong beast that destroys everything in his way. We deal with the likes of him on a daily basis. If you're smart enough, you will deal with him, too.

I have adjusted this visor to Walker's energy. Kill him and come back! I have more tasks for you.

Find and destroy Vigilant.

The Demon can be anywhere outside the capitals, skirmishes and certain special zones.

So, you want to hunt a bigger beast? Your next target is Vigilant.

Some think that this creature is older than elves and stronger than most Great Mages. Well, the time of ancient demons has passed. The older they are, the weaker they get with every day.

But we can't wait for him to die on his own. The world is still in danger while he is alive! So you better hurry up.

I have adjusted this visor to Vigilant's energy. Good luck!
Congratulate 10 Warriors of the maximum level and return to Zabava Mayskaya.

There are more veterans among us than it might seem. We have gone through so many bloody battles in the last century! But the League always comes out victorious, thanks to our strong faith and mighty heroes! As much as we believe in the Light and Tensess, we put our faith into the brave warriors and artful sorcerers that stand guard of our homeland! In these days we need to show them how much we appreciate them and their sacrifice in the name of the League.

There is nothing difficult in that. You just need to congratulate 10 veterans. Sincere words of gratitude will make anyone happy! The more veterans you will congratulate before the Parade starts, the better spot you will get.
Congratulate 10 maximum level characters of the specified class.

There are more veterans among us than it might seem. We have gone through so many bloody battles in the last century! But the Empire always comes out victorious, thanks to our unity, heroism, and wise Yasker's command! As Yasker says, our main purpose is to keep up the morale!

There is nothing difficult in that. You need to congratulate 10 veterans. Sincere words of gratitude will make anyone happy! The more veterans you will congratulate before the Parade starts, the better spot you will get.
Excellent, excellent! You will make the Parade even brighter. Don't forget to complete my requests every day! The more you accomplish, the better spot you will get at the Parade!
Congratulate 10 Bards of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Wardens of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Engineers of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Mages of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Summoners of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Paladins of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Healers of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Psionicists of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Scouts of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Congratulate 10 Warriors of the maximum level and return to Maya Styagina.
Complete 5 daily quests "War Veterans" and return to Maya Styagina.

Good afternoon, citizen! I congratulate you on May Holidays and remind you that soon the Empire's national celebration will take place - the Victory Parade! What do you mean, you didn't know?

Then listen up. By the Imperial edict of Yasker, a ceremonial march is to be organized in the streets of Nezebgrad. The participants of the parade - both resigned and active - will ride the best stallions of the Empire. They will be accompanied by war machinery - old models as well as new ones.

Also, those who help organize the event, will be able to participate, too! Are you interested? I'm not asking for much - you will find pleasure in completing my request yourself. I will tell you more, if you wish.
Even little help will get you into the ranks of the Parade. But those who will put in great efforts, will be allowed to take the best spots!

Outstanding! You have surely put in enough efforts to earn one of the best positions in the Parade ranks. Though if you complete all of my quests before the day of the Parade, you will be granted the honor to ride a snow-white stallion in the lead! It is a very rare horse indeed.

Ah, I almost forgot to congratulate you. May your will be strong and your ally's shoulder never fail you! May no beast withstand your onslaught and most powerful enemy flee at the sight of you!
Complete 5 daily quests "War Veterans" and return to Zabava Mayskaya.

Peace to you, my friend! May is a lovely and merry month. At this time, the League celebrates the anniversary of our victory in the Great Astral Campaign. This year, we have prepared something very special - the Victory Parade!

Imagine it: smooth lines of horses, magnificent machines, war heroes in their splendorous march across the capital city! And what's more, anyone who helps organize the event can participate. It's not that difficult to do - just congratulate the veterans! Not necessarily the participants of the Campaign - all war heroes deserve your appreciation!

Every day I will tell you who you should congratulate. If you complete my requests, you will have my gratitude, a ticket to the Parade, and a very nice reward, of course!

Can you feel the spring coming? Forces of nature are awakening, blood pounding in your veins! Do you feel the urge to perform something outstanding? Heroic?
By order of Aidenus, everyone must be given an opportunity to perform heroic deeds - and to celebrate the victory, of course. Buy Victorious Banner of the League from Silantiy Vinegarov, equip it and go out the the battlefield. Fight the Imperial players and receive the proof of your deed for every defeated player. Defeat more enemies all over Sarnaut, and receive valuable reward!
And don't miss your chance to take part in barbecue contest! A hungry warrior cannot fight! If you eat well, you will defeat more enemies and receive more rewards! Don't you think so?
 Aidenus himself will take part in the celebrations. He will give a speech near his tower every hour. Come and listen! All the guests will receive greeting cards. And if you bring your Guest of Honor papers, they will be stamped to certify that you've witnessed the ceremony.
Complete the entertainment program from the Resort Manager by doing 5 suggested tasks.

Traveler, have you heard about our new entertainment program? It's not just fun - you can also earn generous rewards. New entertainment every day!

But take it easy - while there are enough snowflakes for everyone, if you come to me too often, the reward will be smaller.
Hurry up before the attractions are closed for a break. Go on now!
Did you do everything you wanted? That's great. Here's your well-deserved reward, traveler!
Complete the weekly entertainment program from the Resort Manager by doing 5 daily tasks.
Traveler, now you can get even more snowflakes for the winter entertainment program! Just 5 days of winter activities - and the reward is yours!
How do you like it here? Having fun?

So, are you going to make a snowman? Then you're going to need some branches for the arms, a carrot for the nose, and a lot of snow!

Come on, let's do it!
Greetings, dear friend! Welcome to our village. We live simply and sure know how to have fun! I bet you'll love it here.
Repel the attack of spirits of eternal frost using the Luminary of Joy.

Not everything is perfect at our Snow Resort, yeah? This whole mess with the holidays woke the local Hunhurrs, spirits of eternal frost. The nasty creatures want to feed on our guests’ souls! Agrh! Unforgivable! They will feel the true wrath... Well, not my wrath, and not yours either. It will be that Gibberling that will deal with them.

Here, take this! This thing is sick! It’s called “Luminary of Joy”. Instills indescribable horror into dark creatures. And take this, too! It’s a tincture of local mushrooms and snowdrops. Allows you to see those dark creatures! And other interesting stuff...

Drink and get down to work. Hunhurrs have no business being here, eysh!

Excellent! I guess you deserve a gift, don’t you? Here, take this! I hope there's something good inside. I didn’t peek, I swear.

Hunhurrs will probably be back again, so I might need your help!

And... hand back the tincture, will you?
Join the festive procession in honor of Genlun, the patron of the Tekyan.

Like many other people of our world, Tekyan has their own rituals for celebrating the New Year. Che-Shoo, the guardian of the holy fire on that island, invites his guests to join a ceremonial procession in honor of their crocodile god, Genlun. I heard it’s fun! The Priestess carries divine tea through the whole island, accompanied by the Dragon, Drummer, and dancers.

Che-Shoo himself can tell you what exactly happens there and its sacral meaning. You won’t regret it, aysh!
Well, how did you like the procession?
I told you you wouldn’t regret it! It may look funny but the Tekyan take this ceremony very seriously. And Genlun himself too, by the looks of it!

Find the gifts by participating in activities at the Snow Resort.

(Progress is saved if you abandon the quest.)

Gifts for the New Year have been hidden all over the resort! You can find them in an ice-hole or a snowman. You can discover a gift on the icy lake or on a mountain slope. You can keep the gifts! That’s the whole point...
Well, have you found the gifts?
Not bad! I hope you like them.
Catch an Ice Fish in Crystal Lake.

Yeah! My dream fish! It's right here, under the ice! You don't believe me? A lot of people saw it. It's not easy to catch, though. Firstly, you need a special crystal bait. Secondly, it's attracted to light... Just blow up something, I don’t know! And thirdly, you need luck. And thirdly, you need luck. Fortune favors the stubborn. If you fail today, come back tomorrow. Sooner or later, you'll get lucky.
How is it going? It's not about catching the fish, it's about fishing. Any fisherman could tell you that.
You did it! You really did it! This is your dream fish! See? Destiny sometimes turns out well.
Lure the Ice Fish to the surface

All deep-sea fish are drawn to light. Ice Fish loves New Year's celebrations. It's not scared by fireworks and lights - it's quite the opposite. As it gets closer to the surface, it will be easier to catch.
Now take this tackle and try to catch it. You'll do it this time. I believe in you!
Catch 3 fish in Crystal Lake and bring them to Asp Ershov.

You want to go fishing, right? Be aware that fish in the Crystal Lake is very fastidious. Catching it is tricky, but it's selling like hot cakes! If you want to earn a nice reward, go catch three of them.
Catch me three fish, and I will find a way to thank you!
Nice catch! That's a good haul! A here's your promised reward. If you catch some more, bring them straight to me. You know I'm good for it!
Catch 5 fish in Crystal Lake and bring them to Asp Ershov.

You want to go fishing, right? Be aware that fish in the Crystal Lake is very fastidious. Catching it is tricky, but it's selling like hot cakes! If you want to earn a nice reward, go catch five of them.
Catch me five fish, and I will find a way to thank you!
Nice catch! That's a good haul! A here's your promised reward. If you catch some more, bring them straight to me. You know I'm good for it!
My name is Chereh. I'm kinda in charge here. Watching out for hapless swimmers and jacklighters. But if you want to fish - just ask me for the gear!
I knew you were into fishing right away!
Show your figure skating skills - skate through all the checkpoints on the frozen lake and perform 10 stunts.

Hey? You want to try skating? Don't be shy, it's fun! Even if you fall, it's not a big deal. Nobody's going to laugh!

So, are you in? Great, now take these ice skates and go ahead! And if you skate through all the checkpoints on the lake and perform several simple stunts, you'll win a prize!
If you skate through all the checkpoints on the lake and perform several simple stunts, you'll win a prize!
You were great! You deserve a reward for that!
Catch and raise a Jay mount.

Hello, traveler! Have you ever heard of the Ice Jays?

These mysterious birds can even travel through the astral plane, and no one knows how they do it. They say they serve Winter herself, and build their nests from ice debris on top of the largest glacier in Sarnaut!  Now they came to our resort.

And now, imagine - you can get one of these if you can find an egg and then take care of the fledgling until it grows up.

Our hunter can tell you where to find an egg.
Hard work pays off if you are patient enough!
A unique bird that is hard to find in Sarnaut! Now you have one!
Shoot some game in the forest

There's a lot of fish in the lake, but fish alone isn't nourishing enough. Our fledgling could use a more varied diet. These woods are rich with game. However, we don't need a deer. Five hares and five squirrels will do. I'll give you a bow.
You can do this with a bit of effort!
The fledgling will grow into a big strong bird! Make sure to come back tomorrow.
Collect five sacred flames and keep the egg warm

What could replace mother's warmth for the fledgling? Probably nothing. But there's something that can help. The magic of Light can create lanterns: small fires that produce enough heat to keep a traveler warm. They should be enough for a fledgling. Go to the priest Che-Shi and do as he says, and then warm the owlet.
You can do this with a bit of effort!
It's going to hatch soon! Come back, we need your help!
Every living being needs food. A growing organism needs even more food! As we know, owls and jays are predators. Luckily, there's plenty of fish in local waters. Ten fish should be enough.
You can do this with a bit of effort!
The fledgling will grow into a big strong bird!
Catch and raise an Owl mount.

Greetings, visitor! Have you ever heard about Snow Owls? They're amazing birds.

You can tame one if you raise an owlet. It's not an easy task. Snow Owls are delicate and require special handling. It's hard enough to catch it, let alone help an owlet hatch, and then keep it warm and fed as it grows. I wish you luck if you're up for this.

Go visit our huntress. She lives nearby, at the edge of the forest. If there's anyone who knows where to find Snow Owls, it's her.
You can do this with a bit of effort!
Do you like your new friend? It's not the same as buying something ready-made. You two are very close now.
Take this, it will help you locate their nests in the snow.
Take this, it will help you locate their nests in the snow.
h: I want to tame an Snow Owl!

t: Demonstrate your accuracy by scoring 50 points in flights on Rocs

Would you like to enjoy the scenery and have fun at the same time?

This season we have a new product - hunting tours on rocs. You just need to hunt for explosive spheres!

Everything is simple: hit the blue spheres, don’t hit the red ones. Earn 50 points, and the reward is yours.

And if you turn out to be a very accurate hunter and score 75 or even 100 points, the reward will be increased.

So, ready for a ride?
Don't be afraid, the bird won't drop you even during an intense hunt.
Meet with Che-Go at the Winter Resort.

Dear friend! This year a new attraction awaits you at the Winter Resort. You can ride a Roc and hunt at the same time! Come to our beautiful resort and test your accuracy. My assistant Che-Go will show you everything.
Do not miss this great attraction!
Go to the top of the mountain and ride down.

Want to enjoy a good ride?

Grab your snowboard and let me know when you are ready - I will take you to the top of that mountain. Then you can ride your snowboard down the hill. You'll love it!

And it's not some kind of children's ride with sledges - we conduct this activity according to the rules of the discipline: you can only slide down when the track is carefully prepared for snowboarding maneuvers. Don't worry about missing the start of the race: we will announce it throughout the resort.

Be careful there, the snowboard is not some kind of sled - if you crash into something solid or get off the track, you're done...

Afterwards, come see me. Daredevils who ride on snowboards deserve a reward!
Ask the slalom organizer to take you to the top of the mountain, grab the sledge, and slide down!
Who doesn't enjoy a fast ride? Well, how are you feeling? Did you enjoy it?

You want to try and ride all the way from the top to the foot of this mountain? Well, I'm afraid it's not going to happen right now - the track is not ready yet. We'll tramp down the snow and reattach the ribbons - you know, the usual. Stop by later!

Hey! You want to have the best fun this icy rock has to offer? That can be arranged!

It's called Slalom, and it's the craziest race in the world! It seems simple - you just need to ride the board from the top to the foot. The one who finishes first, wins. However, the track is tricky - you'll have to avoid stones, trees, and other racers, and the speed is crazy! I'm telling you, not everyone is going to make it to the finish line.

Do you still want to participate?

Greetings! Welcome to the foothills of the highest mountain in the region! Only the bravest and reckless will dare to climb it in this weather. The wind is blowing hard, the Elementals are throwing icy boulders at you - lovely, isn't it?

Your mount will help you here – one of the creatures that are adapted to the local conditions: a Snowbug or a Snow Fury. Or even a Snow Owl, one of those that nest on highest slopes - if you can tame it, of course.

The first one to the top wins. The second gets a smaller reward, and the third one an even smaller one. Don't stop, or you'll freeze!
Go to the top of the mountain and slide down on the sledge.

Do you feel like taking a ride on a sledge? We love doing that in our town!

Ask one of the Flight Masters to take you to the top of the mountain, grab the sledge, and slide to the foot! You'll love it!

Be careful - it's not easy to control the sledge and avoid obstacles in your way!

If you manage to get to the finish line, stop by afterwards to collect your reward!

By the way! They say Winter leaves her gifts on the hill...
Ask one of the Flight Masters to take you to the top of the mountain, grab the sledge, and slide to the foot!
You are brave! How did it feel? Did you like it? I'm sure you loved it!
Don't know where you can sledge? No problem! Just one snowflake, and I'll take you to the top of the hill.
h: Get to the top of the hill for sledging

t:
Hey! My name is Brody, also known as Sculptor...

I must say, I'm not a real sculptor yet, but my snowmen are top-notch! There's nothing better than sledging. What? You don't have a sledge? Don't worry, I'll let you borrow mine. Go up there and try it yourself!

We are going to start a real Snow Battle! Do you want to join us?

The rules are simple: some players build fortresses, and others attack them. If a defenders lasts for 3 minutes, they receive a reward. Otherwise, the attackers win!

If you're with us, then remember that you should only build fortresses inside the village! Evil frost spirits are wandering outside.
You should only build fortresses inside the village! Evil frost spirits are wandering outside.
Wow, that was a great battle! Should we do this again?
Hey there! We're playing snowballs here. You want to join us?

Do you like throwing snowballs? Me too! I love that game... I wonder why we didn't like snow back then? It's so white and fluffy... And if you make a snowball, it's round like an orange! Keep in mind that not any snow is suitable for snowballs. We make special piles of snow so that it melts a little - then it's perfect for making snowballs that always hit the target!

You don't believe me? Then try it! Hit five players with snowballs, then come back to get your reward.
Hit five players with snowballs! Don't worry, they won't take it personally!
I told you: a good snowball always hits the target! And a nice hit deserves a reward - here's your snowflake! Come again!
Obtain branches in the forest, a carrot in the village, and make a snowman, then return to Brody Three-Fingered.

You need some branches, a carrot and snow. You will find branches in the forest, a carrot can be easily obtained in the village, and snow is everywhere around us.

You need to make three balls out of snow, then stick the branches where the arms should be and the carrot as a nose - and the snowman is ready!

Try not to place your snowman next to somebody else's. This is not very polite.
You will find branches in the forest, a carrot can be easily obtained in the village, and snow is everywhere around us. Come back when you're done!
Good job, that's a great snowman!

Greetings!

Here you can buy hot tea, cold ale, strong grog, fresh oranges, rich soups, and delicious steaks.

Do you want to have a drink or a snack?
Meet the locals and return to the Elder.

Let me tell you about our village.

Here we have a beautiful frozen lake. There you can try figure skating, and if you long for peace and quiet, you can take a fishing rod and catch some delicious Crystal Fish.

Then, we have an amazing mountain with smooth slopes. There you can take a ride either on a snow board or on a sledge, if you are bold enough!

Also, you can entertain yourself by making snowmen, launching fireworks, and, of course, by playing snowballs. And if you get hungry, stop by the food vendors. They sell most delicious dishes!
How do you like our village? This is the best place in the world, isn't it?

Did you meet everyone? That's great!

Now feel yourself at home. Guests are very welcomed here!

Welcome to our village! Here anyone can find an entertainment to their liking. Figure skating, snowball tournaments, fishing, delicious food, and beautiful fireworks are all here for you. No violence is admitted: in our resort, we don't bear arms even against our worst enemies!

Enjoy yourself, have fun, and don't forget to buy a souvenir!
Meet with Captain Solonus at the Eljune Bazaar.

Hello, !

We haven't seen each other for a while. How is it going?

My travels brought me to the Eljune Bazaar. Chewacca and I are helping the Free Traders organize a Black Market. This place can really use one! Anything can be sold to any part of Sarnaut. Need something you can't find in the markets of your capital? No problem! We can legitimize any goods, even those provided by your enemies.

Drop by anytime. Don't forget the coin you got with this letter.
Ah, you've come! Give me your coin. It's not just a coin! It's your ticket to an exciting world of not-quite-legal trade.
{giver} is waiting for you in a location called {zone}.
The adventure might be not over just yet. Go to the location called {zone} as soon as you can. {giver} is waiting for you there. There is a grand quest ahead, so don't waste time!
